editorial:
Detective Mark Hoffman is being praised as a hero after Jigsaw's death, but Agent Strahm isn't buying it. He starts digging into Hoffman's past and uncovers some dark secrets. At the same time, a new group of people gets trapped in another deadly game with brutal traps. The movie jumps between the investigation and the new victims' struggles, keeping you guessing about who will survive. It's a tense, bloody ride that fans of the series will enjoy, though it leans heavily on flashbacks to fill in the story.

The acting is solid, especially from the leads, and the traps are as nasty as ever. The pacing moves fast, but the story can feel a bit messy with all the back-and-forth. If you love gore and puzzles, you'll have fun. If you're new to the series, start earlier. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Strahm tracks Hoffman to a room where he thinks he's caught the killer. But Hoffman has set a trap. Strahm gets locked inside a glass box that slowly fills with water, drowning him. Hoffman walks away free, now fully in control of Jigsaw's legacy. The twist is that Hoffman planned everything, including framing Strahm. The movie ends with Hoffman escaping, setting up more chaos to come.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves bloody horror and twisty crime stories.
